### Epicurus on life

Epicurus (341–270 BCE) approaches life within Epicureanism. Pleasure is the beginning and end of the blessed life—chiefly absence of bodily pain and mental disturbance, not endless luxury. Natural and necessary desires are few; empty desires breed anxiety. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets life most directly—useful for searches such as “epicurus quotes on life.”
